blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The defense panel for Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial was properly informed about the inclusion of the financial forensic analyst as among the prosecution’s witnesses, private lawyer Benjamin Tolosa Jr. said. Tolosa, in an ambush interview on Thursday after the Senate Impeachment Court decided to suspend trial for the meantime, said he wanted to clarify and dispute the defense’s insinuations that financial forensic analyst Atty. Alexander Cabrera was a last-minute substitute to the Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR) representative. According to Tolosa, Cabrera’s possible testimony and his report were provided to the defense and the impeachment court last […]...
